title: 1992 AHSME Problem 4
statement: If \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) are positive integers and \(a\) and \(b\) are odd, then \(3^a+(b-1)^2c\) is

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: odd if \(c\) is even; even if \(c\) is odd

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: odd if \(c\) is odd; even if \(c\) is even

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
odd if \(c\) is not a multiple of \(3\); even if \(c\) is a
multiple of \(3\)

solutions.text:
The power \(3^a\) is odd. Since \(b-1\) is even, \((b-1)^2c\) is even for every positive integer \(c.\) The sum of an odd integer and an even integer is always odd.

Thus the correct answer is A.
